title: direct labels over legends
name: Direct labels over legends — NSW
rule: Direct labels over legends; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices; doughnut preferred in digital. Legend only when direct labels fail; keep it readable at 200% zoom. Stacked bar: 3–4 segments. Multi-line: 3–4 series. Horizontal bar when category labels are long.
pass_when: Direct labels where they fit; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices (doughnut preferred on digital); stacked bar / multi-line 3–4; long categories use horizontal bar.
fail_when: Legend as the only labels when direct labels would fit; pie with many slices; many stacked segments or lines.
overview: Prefer direct labels; limit pie, stacked, and multi-line series counts.
apply_when: Labeling series on pies, stacked bars, and multi-line charts.
not_when: Legend-only when direct labels fit, or too many slices, segments, or lines.
agent_hint: Prefer direct labels; keep pie 2–4 slices and stacked or multi-line series to 3–4.
description: Prefer direct labels over legends; pie or doughnut 2–4 slices (doughnut preferred on digital). Legend only when direct labels fail; keep it readable at 200% zoom. Stacked bar 3–4 segments; multi-line 3–4 series; horizontal bar for long category labels. Pass when those limits and direct-label preference hold. Fail when legend is the only label path though direct labels would fit, pie has many slices, or there are many stacked segments or lines.
do_not_claim: A house choice-cutoff for form controls.
